# Paper

Sheet of material with elevation

## Overview

- **Category**: surfaces
- **Base Library**: mui
- **MUI Component**: Paper

## Installation

```bash
npm install @lsy-netline/netline-ui
```

## Import

```typescript
import { Paper } from '@lsy-netline/netline-ui';
```

## Basic Usage

```tsx
<Paper elevation={3} sx={{ p: 2 }}>
  Content with elevation
</Paper>
```

## Examples

```tsx
<Paper elevation={3} sx={{ p: 2 }}>
  Content with elevation
</Paper>
```

## MUI Reference

This component is based on Material-UI's Paper.

For additional props and detailed API documentation, refer to:

- [MUI Paper Documentation](https://mui.com/material-ui/api/paper/)
